result.title: Optimal Transport PAC-Bayes Bounds
result.summary: PAC-Bayesian generalization bounds are among the strongest distribution-dependent guarantees in statistical learning and are typically expressed in terms of the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between a prior and posterior distribution. While analytically convenient, the KL divergence requires the posterior to be absolutely continuous w.r.t. the prior, imposing support constraints that can substantially restrict the choice of posterior. Moreover, the KL divergence does not account for the underlying geometry of the probability space. In this work, we derive new PAC-Bayesian bounds replacing the KL divergence with general optimal transport (OT) distances, including the total variation and Wasserstein-$p$ distances.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文将 PAC-Bayes 泛化界中的 KL 散度替换为一般最优传输（OT）距离（含全变差距离与 Wasserstein-p 距离），推出新的分布相关泛化界，以放宽支撑约束并引入概率空间几何信息。
